names.display_en: Liu Cong, Ancestor Lie of Han (Former Zhao)

summary: 杀兄和自立，在位八年；永嘉五年陷洛阳俘怀帝，建兴四年陷长安灭西晋，武功极盛；然游猎无度、后宫侈靡，史载记批评之甚。
summary_en: He slew his brother He to take the throne and reigned eight years; in the 5th year of Yongjia he took Luoyang and captured Emperor Huai, and in the 4th of Jianxing took Chang'an and ended Western Jin — his arms at their height; but his hunting and his harem drew the historians' sharpest censure.

portrait.appearance_basis: 史载无形貌描写。画像宜表现骄盈暴虐的胡族君主之态，衣冠从匈奴汉国制。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 即位
timeline.summary: 杀兄和自立，改元光兴，是为烈宗。
timeline.summary_en: He slew his brother He and took the throne, changing the era to Guangxing.

timeline.title: 陷洛阳
timeline.summary: 刘曜、王弥等破洛阳，俘怀帝，杀王公士民，史称永嘉之乱高峰。
timeline.summary_en: Liu Yao and Wang Mi broke Luoyang, captured Emperor Huai, and slew the princes and people — the summit of the Yongjia disaster.

timeline.title: 杀怀帝于平阳
timeline.summary: 怀帝被俘至平阳，青衣行酒，为聪所杀。
timeline.summary_en: Emperor Huai, brought to Pingyang in captivity, was made to serve wine in servant's dress, then put to death by Cong.

timeline.title: 陷长安灭西晋
timeline.summary: 刘曜破长安，愍帝出降，西晋亡。
timeline.summary_en: Liu Yao took Chang'an, Emperor Min surrendered, and Western Jin was no more.

timeline.title: 刘聪崩
timeline.summary: 崩，子粲继，旋为靳准所杀，政权分裂。
timeline.summary_en: He died; his son Can succeeded and was at once slain by Jin Zhun, and the realm split.

timeline.title: 游猎与后宫
timeline.summary: 史载游猎无度、后宫侈靡，为载记批评焦点。
timeline.summary_en: The records harp on his boundless hunting and his extravagant harem.

relations.note_en: After the Jin Zhun Rebellion in the 3rd year of Linjia, Yao claims the imperial throne at Chang'an

bio_md:
# 汉（前赵）烈宗 · 主要事迹

刘聪字载明，刘渊第四子。永嘉四年，杀兄和自立，改元光兴。聪在位八年，武功极盛：永嘉五年，遣刘曜、王弥等破洛阳，俘晋怀帝，杀王公士民三万余人，「永嘉之乱」于此为最；建兴元年，怀帝于平阳青衣行酒，为聪所杀；建兴四年，刘曜破长安，俘愍帝，西晋亡——中国北方，自此尽入胡汉诸国之手。

然刘聪之治，暴虐失德：史载其游猎无度、后宫侈靡，「食则太官，衣则御府」，宠信靳准等佞臣；建兴末又杀愍帝于平阳，弑君之罪，无所忌惮。麟嘉三年，刘聪崩，子粲继，旋为靳准所杀，汉国分裂——刘曜于长安继位改号赵，石勒于襄国称赵王，前赵后赵并立之局始成。

刘聪以灭晋之功，居五胡君主武功之首；然「得天下不以仁义」，其暴政使匈奴汉国仅二世而衰。聪之灭晋，标志五胡十六国之局全面展开：北方自此无复统一，而南朝偏安之局，亦由此定。

> 参考：点校本《晋书》卷102《刘聪载记》、卷005《怀帝纪》。

bio_parts_en.value:
Liu Cong, styled Zaiming, was the fourth son of Liu Yuan. In the 4th year of Yongjia he slew his brother He to take the throne, changing the era to Guangxing. His eight years reached the height of arms: in the 5th year of Yongjia he sent Liu Yao and Wang Mi to break Luoyang, capturing Emperor Huai and slaying over thirty thousand princes, officials, and people — the summit of the Yongjia disaster; in the 1st year of Jianxing the captive emperor, made to serve wine in servant's dress, was put to death at Pingyang; in the 4th year of Jianxing Liu Yao took Chang'an and captured Emperor Min — Western Jin was at an end, and the north had passed to the barbarian and half-barbarian states.

His rule was tyranny: the records harp on his boundless hunting and extravagant harem, his favoring of the flatterer Jin Zhun; and he put Emperor Min to death without scruple. In the 3rd year of Linjia he died; his son Can succeeded and was at once slain by Jin Zhun, and the realm split — Liu Yao took the throne at Chang'an and renamed the realm Zhao, while Shi Le styled himself King of Zhao at Xiangguo: the age of Former Zhao and Later Zhao had begun.

For destroying the Jin, Cong stands first in arms among the Five Barbarian sovereigns; but he "won the realm without benevolence," and his tyranny brought the Xiongnu Han state low within two generations. His destruction of Western Jin opened the full age of the Sixteen States: the north would know no unity, and the southern courts' long isolation was fixed.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Jinshu*, ch. 102 (records of Liu Cong), ch. 5 ("Benji of Emperor Huai").
